propositions: Two new blocking deterministic checks (P10 verification-presence and P11 ac-vagueness) are implemented as separate DET rules rather than modifications to the advisory P6 check.

P10 blocks leaf plans lacking a Testing/Verification H2 section, code-span AC items, or AC items matching the verification vocabulary (pytest, test_, make, rebar, git, grep, assert, checked:, verif*, exit code).

P11 applies fixed lexicon matching with word boundaries to AC item lines only, drops 'clean' as a vague term, exempts 'etc.' within 30 characters after code spans, and records inline code-span positions on original lines before blanking.
The fixed vague lexicon is synchronized between P11 blocking and P6 advisory surfaces to ensure consistent matching behavior.
P6 remains advisory; existing test posture assertions are re-confirmed across three updated test files.
Documentation is extended in plan-review-gate.md's deterministic-floor section with P10 and P11 descriptions.
